title: Velvety Nostalgic Ukrainian Cobnut Pilaf
description: A funky, velvety vegetarian-friendly dish featuring cobnuts, a traditional Ukrainian ingredient that adds both texture and flavor to this nostalgic treat.
instructions: Heat vegetable broth in a pot over medium heat.
Slice the onion and garlic cloves finely, sauté them in oil until translucent.
Add sliced carrots to the pot, stirring occasionally.
Crush cobnuts and add them to the pot with a handful of water. Bring to a boil.
If using stuffed cabbage leaves, prepare them by filling the leaves with the pilaf mixture. Place in a casserole dish.
Reduce heat to low, cover and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
